title: Configuration
menu_subtitle: Pricing, fleet configuration, branches and channels
panel_note: The rate matrix, date rule and campaign editors are in the panel; the app shows records, switches them on or off and makes small edits.
activate_body: The draft takes effect; the previous active version is superseded.
deactivate_body: The record is no longer used for new sales.
sections.preview_hint: Price a rental with the current prices
sections.segments_hint: Commercial classes such as Economy, SUV
sections.one_way_hint: Return permission and fee between branches
sections.capacity_hint: Sales limit, guaranteed quota, safety margin
check_ready: The draft is ready to activate.
bands_in_panel: Bands and prices are edited in the panel.
rules_in_panel: The rule's dates, scope and value are edited in the panel.
matrix_pick_branch: Pick a branch in the menu.
extras_in_panel: Prices, per-product prices and extra settings are edited in the panel.
campaigns_in_panel: Campaign rules, scope and limits are edited in the panel.
attributes_in_panel: Attributes, guarantee and versions are edited in the panel.
hours_in_panel: Working hours, holidays, location and adding delivery points are done in the panel.
channel_settings_in_panel: Push / pull settings and sync actions are managed in the panel.
preview_drafts_in_panel: Comparing with a draft plan or rule, extras and the delivery fee are in the panel.
validation.stock: Enter a whole number between 0 and 100000.
